# List of PMF

1. $$P(x) = \frac{x - 3}{6}, \quad \text{for } x = 4, 5, 6$$

2. $$P(x) = \frac{3x + 4}{21}, \quad x = 0, 1, 2$$

3. $$P(X) = \frac{3-\vert 4-x\vert}{k}; \quad x = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6$$

4. $$P(X) = \frac{5-\vert 6-x\vert}{k}; \quad x = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5$$

5. $$P(X) = \frac{7-\vert 5-x\vert}{k}; \quad x = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6$$

6. $$P(X) = \frac{6-\vert 7-x\vert}{k}; \quad x = 1, 2, \cdots, 10$$

7. $$P(x) = \frac{x+1}{k}; \quad x = 1, 2, 3, 4$$

8. $$P(x) = \frac{2x+k}{56}; \quad x = -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3$$

9. $$P(x) = \frac{1}{14} (a+2x); \quad x = -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3$$

10. $$P(x) = k(x-2); \quad x = 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8$$

11. $$P(x) = \frac{x-1}{k}; \quad x = 2, 3, 4, 5$$

12. $$p(x) = \frac{x+4}{30}; \quad x = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4$$

13. $$P(x) = \frac{2x+1}{9}; \quad x = 0, 1, 2$$

    Is it a PMF?

## Joint PMF

1. $$P(X,Y) = \frac{x + 2y}{28}; \quad x = 0, 1; \quad y = 0, 1, 2, 3$$

2. $$P(X,Y) = \frac{2x + 3y}{45}; \quad x = 0, 1, 2; \quad y = 0, 1, 2$$

3. $$P(X,Y) = \frac{x + y + 1}{42}; \quad x = 0, 1, 2; \quad y = 0, 1, 2, 3$$

4. $$P(X,Y) = \frac{2x + y + 1}{52}; \quad x = 1, 2; \quad y = 1, 2, 3, 4$$

5. $$P(X,Y) = \frac{3x + y}{48}; \quad x = 1, 2; \quad y = 0, 1, 2, 3$$

6. $$P(x,y) = \frac{1}{21}(x+y); \quad x = 1, 2, 3; \quad y = 1, 2$$

7. $$P(x,y) = \frac{x+y}{9}; \quad x = 0, 1, 2; \quad y = 0, 1$$

# PDF

1. $$f(x) = 6x(1-x); \quad 0 \le x \le 1$$

2. $$f(z) = \frac{2}{9} (3z - z^2); \quad 0 \le z \le 3$$

3. $$f(x) = k(x+1); \quad 0 \le x \le 1$$

4. $$f(x) = kx(x-1); \quad 1 \le x \le 4$$

5. $$f(x) = kx^2 + kx + \frac{1}{8}; \quad 0 \le x \le 2$$

6. $$f(x) = \frac{1}{30} (k+2x); \quad 2 < x < 5$$

7. $$f(x) = 2x; \quad 0 < x < 1$$

8. $$f(x) = \frac{1}{30} (3+2x); \quad 2 < x < 5$$

9. $$f(x) = ax^2; \quad 0 < x < 4$$

10. $$f(x) = kx; \quad 0 < x < 4$$

11. $$f(x) = 3x^2; \quad 0 \le x \le 1$$

12. $$f(y) = k(3y+5); \quad 1 < y < 5$$

13. $$f(x) = \frac{1}{b-a}; \quad a \le x \le b$$
